products.title: Tana Belt
products.body_html:
Embracing sustainability doesn't mean sacrificing performance.

Our brand-new Tana woven belts are stretchable, flexible, and built to last, all while treading lightly on the planet. Crafted with a unique woven fabric, made from recycled plastic waste, accompanied with a nickel and lead-free pewter finish buckle, these belts offer unmatched adjustability, accommodating shifts in weight and style effortlessly.

With four contemporary colours to choose from, the Tana belt is the essential accessory on the course or in the club house.

Further information on the belts:

  • Repreve is a recycled polyester fibre made from recycled plastic waste.
  • The process of creating Repreve involves collecting plastic waste, cleaning, and crushing them into small pieces, melting the pieces down, and then spinning them into polyester yarn.
  • The trim is made from recycled and discarded leather, and the buckle is lead and nickel free to avoid possible allergies.
  • We use the equivalent of 7 plastic bottles to produce one belt.
  • Recycled belt built for everyday wear and durability.
